description: Port the TUI Trades/Liquidity screen to the web: trade history with per-trade cost basis, exchange liquidity summary with average cost, and cost basis summary showing cold storage and total holdings. BTC implied as default.

timing.gatingCondition: Proceed after web ledger and import features establish stable patterns.

principles: Bitcoin-Centric - BTC is the default coin; no coin dropdown needed
TUI Logic, Web Presentation - reuse existing TradeQuery and balance methods rather than duplicating logic
Cost Basis First - every trade shows unit cost and total cost in USD, the liquidity view is all about cost basis
Desktop Depth, Mobile Utility - trade table is rich on desktop, summary cards work on phone
Read-Only View - this feature is purely analytical; no write operations

techStack.frontend: Responsive web UI with tab toggle, data tables, and summary cards

userStories.title: Trades API endpoints, models, and service layer
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/trades returns paginated trade history with cost basis fields
GET /api/trades/liquidity returns per-exchange summary with current balances and cost basis summary
Exchange filter supported on trades endpoint
userStories.testStrategy: pytest API tests for both endpoints, filter, pagination, empty data
userStories.closureNotes: Created routes/trades.py, services/trades.py, 5 Pydantic models, 10 passing tests

userStories.title: Trade History web view with pagination
acceptanceCriteria: New Trades sidebar nav item between Ledger and Record
Trade History table with Date, Type, Quantity, Trade Currency, Unit Cost, Total Cost, Exchange columns
userStories.closureNotes: Added sidebar nav, trades-view HTML, loadTrades/renderTrades JS, pagination

userStories.title: Liquidity web view with cost basis summary
acceptanceCriteria: Tab toggle between Trade History and Liquidity sub-views
Exchange summary table with Total Purchased, Current Balance, Avg Cost columns
Cost Basis Summary panel with total purchased, USD spent, avg cost, exchange balance, cold storage, total holdings
userStories.testStrategy: Manual verification, API tests cover data correctness
userStories.closureNotes: Added liquidity panel with summary cards, tab toggle, loadLiquidity/renderLiquidity JS

userStories.title: Exchange filter and responsive polish
acceptanceCriteria: Exchange filter dropdown populated from liquidity data
Tab toggle styled with active state
Empty state messages for no-data scenarios
userStories.closureNotes: Exchange dropdown populated from liquidity API, CSS tab styling, empty states

high: Cost basis calculations depend on price lookup availability; missing prices show as dashes
medium: Large trade histories (500+) may be slow to paginate since all trades are fetched then sliced
low: Core trade query and balance logic is well-tested in TUI
Read-only feature with no write operations to worry about

preFlightChecklist: RESOLVED: BTC hardcoded as default coin, no coin dropdown
RESOLVED: Tab toggle pattern for Trade History vs Liquidity sub-views
RESOLVED: Exchange filter populated from liquidity endpoint (complete exchange list)
RESOLVED: Server-side pagination for trades, no pagination for liquidity
